goal: Issue #429 (Spec docs/specs/antigravity-mcp-workspace-resolution.spec.md). Resolve the active session workspace per MCP tool call in priority order: (1) tools/call params._meta["antigravity.google/workspace_paths"][0], (2) the first valid file:// root URI from MCP roots/list, (3) options.cwd ?? process.cwd(), binding that workspace on ClaudeRuntime and workspace-scoped MCP helpers before dispatching status or execution tools. In createAntigravityMcpRuntime and capability.ts, trust Antigravity initialize client names ("antigravity-client" and "antigravity"), normalize an optional leading "v" in parseSemver (such as "v1.0.0"), delegate Antigravity serveStdio to the shared bidirectional stdio server with roots/list support, and narrow the module-level CLI entrypoint guards so dist/antigravity/mcp-server.mjs starts only the Antigravity server. Regenerate the Claude and Antigravity plugin bundles with no new host-to-host import edge.

acceptance.assertion: Spec AC1 and BR-SCN-1 (BR-REQ-1, BR-DEC-2; D1, D2, D3, D6). Done looks like: an Antigravity MCP server started outside the Lane worktree resolves and binds the session workspace per call in priority order (_meta["antigravity.google/workspace_paths"][0] -> MCP roots/list first file:// URI -> options.cwd ?? process.cwd()). Seam: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe "MCP workspace resolution". Positive: (1) with createAntigravityMcpRuntime({ cwd: pluginDir }) and an enrolled task in laneDir, handleJsonRpc tools/call for status and advance_assurance with params._meta["antigravity.google/workspace_paths"] = [laneDir] returns the enrolled Lane claim, run_id, and config.project_key for laneDir (not pluginDir) and advances the task in laneDir; (2) over serveStdio with cwd: pluginDir, when _meta is absent and the client advertises capabilities.roots and answers roots/list with [{ uri: pathToFileURL(laneDir).href }], status projects laneDir, and notifications/roots/list_changed invalidates the cached root so the next call re-queries roots/list. Negative: (1) _meta["antigravity.google/workspace_paths"] set to [], [""], or ["relative/path"] and roots/list returning [{ uri: "https://example.com/repo" }] fall back to pluginDir (claim: null); (2) roots/list returning a JSON-RPC error falls back to pluginDir. Bound: (1) when _meta names laneDir and roots/list names otherDir, status projects laneDir; (2) a call with _meta: [laneDir] followed by a call with no _meta and no roots capability re-binds pluginDir (claim: null).

Spec AC2 and BR-SCN-1 (BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-1; D4, D5). Done looks like: Antigravity initialize handshakes with clientInfo.name "antigravity-client" or "antigravity" and v-prefixed semver ("v1.0.0") bind a trusted host version and admit Lane Executor tools, while untrusted, unversioned, or below-minimum sessions fail closed with Antigravity reasons. Seam: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe "MCP host probe gates". Positive: (1) parseSemver("v1.0.0") returns [1, 0, 0] and probeHost({}, "darwin", "v1.0.0") returns ok: true; (2) handleJsonRpc initialize on createAntigravityMcpRuntime with clientInfo { name: "antigravity-client", version: "v1.0.0" } (and { name: "antigravity", version: "1.0.0" }) and capabilities { elicitation: {} } returns serverInfo.name "antigravity" and minimumHostVersion "0.1.0", admits advance_assurance past unsupported_host, and reaches run_entry_required on start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch. Negative: (1) parseSemver("vv1.0.0"), parseSemver("v1.0"), and parseSemver("1.0.0-beta") return null; (2) initialize with clientInfo { name: "untrusted-client", version: "v1.0.0" } or { name: "antigravity-client", version: "" } (with env ANTIGRAVITY_VERSION=1.0.0) refuses start_unattended_batch and advance_assurance with "unsupported_host: Antigravity version is unavailable"; (3) initialize with { name: "antigravity-client", version: "v0.0.9" } refuses start_unattended_batch, retire_stale_batch, and advance_assurance with "unsupported_host: Antigravity version v0.0.9 is older than minimum supported 0.1.0". Bound: createMcpRuntime (Claude default) initialized with { name: "antigravity-client", version: "v1.0.0" } refuses start_unattended_batch with "unsupported_host: Claude Code version is unavailable".

Spec AC3 (BR-REQ-3; D7, D8). Done looks like: the packaged Antigravity bundle dist/antigravity/mcp-server.mjs runs only the Antigravity entrypoint (writing one reply per request with serverInfo.name "antigravity"), both plugin bundles match fresh builds with zero drift, and the 4-edge host-to-host import baseline is unchanged. Seam: tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts and tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts plus the two build --check scripts. Positive: (1) spawning node dist/antigravity/mcp-server.mjs with initialize (id: 1) and tools/list (id: 2) produces exactly 2 reply lines with replies[0].result.serverInfo.name === "antigravity" and minimumHostVersion === "0.1.0"; (2) bun scripts/build-antigravity-plugin.ts --check and bun scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts --check exit 0, and tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts passes with its 4-edge #414 baseline. Negative: removing dist/antigravity/mcp-server.mjs in a relocated copy fails launch and reports "hook command: missing dist/antigravity/mcp-server.mjs". Bound: spawning node plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs with initialize (id: 1) produces serverInfo.name === "claude-code" and minimumHostVersion === "2.1.236".
